page_title: GEN 1-0 UDI | Genoa v Udinese 04/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Udinese for a penalty. Play continues.
90+5' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Udinese due to an offside in the build-up play.
90+4' Referee Daniele Perenzoni makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether the goal can stand. Let’s see what happens!
90+4' GOAL! Rui Modesto (Udinese) got to the ball in front of the goal and he couldn't miss from there. His low drive went in off the right-hand post. The score is 1:1.
90+2' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
90+2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
87' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 1:2.
86' Martin Payero (Udinese) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
84' Substitution. Alessandro Zanoli is replaced by Junior Messias (Genoa).
83' Substitution. Morten Thorsby walks off the pitch and Lior Kassa (Genoa) comes on as a substitute.
83' Patrick Vieira has decided to make a change. Alan Matturro (Genoa) replaces Johan Vasquez.
83' The ball is out of play. Genoa will have a chance to score from a corner.
82' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) has a huge chance to score from close range, but his effort goes just a few inches wide of the right-hand post.
82' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Maduka Okoye is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
80' The manager makes a subsitution with Simone Pafundi (Udinese) coming on for Iker Bravo.
79' Here is a change. Kingsley Ehizibue is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Thomas Kristensen (Udinese).
77' 1 - 0 Goal! Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) fires the rebound into the top left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
74' Good work from Udinese as they win a corner.
74' Nicola Leali makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Rui Modesto (Udinese) after a cross from the side.
73' The total number of attempts is 8:3.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rui Modesto (Udinese) replaces Oier Zarraga.
70' Substitution. Sandi Lovric (Udinese) has come on for Arthur Atta.
69' Patrick Vieira has decided to substitute Ruslan Malinovsky and he is replaced by Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
66' Daniele Perenzoni couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) and blew his whistle.
62' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp comes off the pitch to be replaced by Martin Payero (Udinese).
60' The ball possession is 58:42.
58' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
56' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Perenzoni had an easy-decision to make.
55' Here comes a substitution. Jean Onana (Genoa) is brought on as a substitute for Patrizio Masini.

54' This was a piece of cake for Maduka Okoye. Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went towards the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
51' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Perenzoni blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Daniele Perenzoni shows a yellow card to Morten Thorsby (Genoa) for his blatant foul.
47' Close! Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' The game is interrupted. Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
41' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
39' Aaron Martin (Genoa) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
37' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Daniele Perenzoni due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) and his team.
36' Udinese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
33' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies just over the bar.
32' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Aaron Martin (Genoa), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
29' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
26' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) has tested the patience of referee Daniele Perenzoni and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
25' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:0.

23' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
21' Rough tackle by Morten Thorsby (Genoa). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
16' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) commits a rough foul. Daniele Perenzoni stops the game and makes a call.
14' 57:43 – the ratio of ball possession.
12' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
10' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
8' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Daniele Perenzoni blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Maduka Okoye pulls off a fantastic save! Morten Thorsby (Genoa) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out.
4' Udinese hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
2' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Genoa will have the kick-off.
Daniele Perenzoni was nominated as the referee for this game.
